notes: Identity verified from supplied full primary Research Report: title The Price Had Better Be Right: Women’s Reactions to Sexual Stimuli Vary With Market Factors; authors Kathleen D. Vohs, Jaideep Sengupta, Darren W. Dahl; DOI 10.1177/0956797613502732; Psychological Science 2014, 25(1), 278–283, online November 2013. Complete article through references. No PDF supplied; no rendering performed. Only assigned n_o and es_value_o evaluated; all unassigned fields are placeholders. Effect metric preserved exactly as canonical notation without conversion. The design identifies 47 women among 87 sexual-condition participants, but does not explicitly give a final analytic female count for the target contrast. Candidate N: 47 women; 87 is the broader sexual-condition design count. Same-test printed p < .01. The distinct omnibus ad-attitude interaction is F(1, 83) = 4.97, p < .05, hp2 = .056; the narrative explicitly identifies the women-only price contrast as the target.
